decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to use ramp spells and Eldrazi creatures to control the game and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures. By utilizing cards like Disciple of Freyalise and Eldrazi Temple to accelerate mana production, the deck aims to cast big threats like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Emrakul, the Promised End quickly. The inclusion of control spells like Ugin, Eye of the Storms and Kozilek's Command helps to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining board presence. Overall, the deck's strategy revolves around using Eldrazi creatures to outvalue and outlast the opponent.

This Aggro Red Deck Wins archetype focuses on fast-paced, aggressive plays to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck includes a low mana curve with a focus on efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Boros Charm, backed up by creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear. The goal is to swarm the board with creatures early on and systematically chip away at the opponent's life total, while also utilizing cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel to punish the opponent for casting spells. The deck prioritizes speed and direct damage to secure a quick victory.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption. By using cards like Counterspell, Force of Negation, Fatal Push, and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and prevent them from executing their win condition. Additionally, cards like Wan Shi Tong, Librarian, Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, and Subtlety provide card advantage and help maintain control of the battlefield. The deck also includes a few creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Orcish Bowmasters for additional threats and disruption.

The deck revolves around putting creatures into the graveyard quickly and efficiently, then casting Living End to bring them all back onto the battlefield at once. The deck includes cards that allow for card draw, mana acceleration, and protection from opposing spells. The strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with a sudden influx of powerful creatures while disrupting their plans with counterspells and control elements. The key is to carefully manage resources and timing to maximize the impact of Living End and outmaneuver the opponent.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with abilities that generate mana and tutor for specific creatures to create a powerful board state quickly. By tutoring for key creatures like Devoted Druid and Walking Ballista, the deck can assemble a combo win condition. Leyline of Abundance and Nature's Rhythm help generate additional mana to accelerate the combo. Agatha's Soul Cauldron and Malevolent Rumble provide disruption and control against opponent's strategies. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption. It's centered around using Teferi, Time Raveler to bounce threats, Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to strip opponents of their key cards, and Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict to deal with creatures. The deck also includes card draw in the form of Psyhic Frog and Enduring Curiosity, as well as ways to protect itself with Spell Snare and Subtlety. Overall, the deck aims to outlast and outvalue the opponent through careful resource management and disruption.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with cards like Street Wraith and Faithless Looting to enable the recursion of Vengevine and Detective's Phoenix. The deck aims to play aggressive creatures like Hollow One and Blazing Rootwalla early on to pressure the opponent while also utilizing cards like Burning Inquiry to disrupt the opponent's hand size. Lightning Bolt and Marauding Mako provide additional removal and reach to close out the game. Overall, the deck focuses on explosive starts and graveyard synergies to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by countering opponent's spells, removing threats from the board, and drawing cards to maintain card advantage. It utilizes a variety of powerful control cards such as Teferi, Time Raveler, Counterspell, and Narset, Parter of Veils to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes powerful win conditions like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Isochron Scepter to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Solitude and Prismatic Ending for spot removal and board control.

This deck focuses on playing efficient and aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, backed up by powerful burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The deck also utilizes card selection and graveyard manipulation through cards like Preordain and Mishra's Bauble to maintain its aggression and consistency. The mana base is designed to support the deck's fast-paced gameplay with fetch lands and shock lands to ensure the right colors are available when needed.

The deck focuses on utilizing Song of Creation to draw and play multiple cards each turn, while also generating mana with Mox Amber and Mox Opal. It includes various ways to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's strategy, such as Engineered Explosives and Tormod's Crypt. The deck also includes key cards like Urza's Saga and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to further enhance the combo potential. Overall, the strategy revolves around quickly assembling the combo pieces and overwhelming the opponent with card advantage and powerful spells.

This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand using cards like Goryo's Vengeance, while also utilizing instant spells like Ephemerate and Faithful Mending to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes creatures like Fallaji Archaeologist and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to provide additional value and control options. It aims to efficiently reanimate threats and control the board to secure victory through its powerful combo potential and flexible instant spells.

The deck focuses on aggressively attacking the opponent while utilizing blink effects to repeatedly trigger powerful abilities of creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By combining aggressive creatures with blinking them in and out of play, the deck aims to pressure the opponent and control the board effectively. The deck includes a mix of strong creatures with valuable enter-the-battlefield effects, removal spells for disruption, and lands to support the strategy. Ultimately, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and tactical maneuvering through blink effects.

The deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures to power up Cosmogoyf, while using effects like Spoils of the Vault and Plunge into Darkness to search for combo pieces. Cards like Devourer of Destiny and Aloe Alchemist provide additional graveyard fuel, while Thud allows for explosive finishers by sacrificing Cosmogoyf. Inquisition of Kozilek disrupts opponents' strategies, and Gemstone Caverns and Chancellor of the Dross help cheat out key cards early. The deck utilizes a mix of ramp, disruption, and combo pieces to quickly overwhelm opponents and secure the win.

This deck focuses on generating mana quickly with cards like Ruby Medallion and Rituals in order to cast multiple spells in a turn. By casting spells like Reckless Impulse and Wrenn's Resolve, you can dig through your deck for key combo pieces like Past in Flames and Grapeshot. Ral, Monsoon Mage can help draw extra cards and ping your opponent for damage. The deck aims to create a storm of spells, maximizing the efficiency of each spell cast to overwhelm your opponent and secure a victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Faithless Looting and Thought Scour to fill the graveyard with creatures, then reanimating them using spells such as Unearth and Persist. The key strategy is to quickly reanimate powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Emperor of Bones to overwhelm the opponent and gain control of the game. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board and protect the combo. Ultimately, the goal is to bring out big threats early and close out the game before the opponent has a chance to respond.

The primary focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a variety of disruptive spells and abilities to hinder the opponent's strategy. Cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation help to disrupt the opponent's hand and counter their key spells, while cards like Fatal Push and Sheoldred's Edict help to remove threats from the board. The deck also includes a mix of counter spells, removal spells, and card draw engines to maintain control of the game and outvalue the opponent. Overall, the deck aims to establish dominance through disruption and control.
